title: Other remote viewing teams trained by Pat Price and Joe McMoneagle

tellings.quote: rumors about the fact that there was other teams of remote viewers being trained by uh by Pat Price and Joe McGonagal other than than put off.

plain: There were rumours, Michels says, that besides the remote viewers working with the physicist Hal Puthoff, other teams were trained by two of the programme's viewers, Pat Price and Joe McMoneagle. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe a distant place or target with the mind alone, which US government programmes tested from the 1970s on. Michels raises this himself as rumour, without naming a source; if true, the psychic spying effort was wider than the one known group.
